ideas.title: Investigation into $6.5 million fraud scheme involving Minnesota crime prevention group
ideas.description: This story would investigate the $6.5 million fraud scheme involving a Minnesota crime prevention group championed by Democrats.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and determine who was involved in the scheme
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice.
